hints.title: Separating Vowels
hints.text: Extract all vowels while remembering the indices where they occur in the string.

hints.title: Character Code Sorting
hints.text: Sort the collected vowel characters by their character code values in ascending order.

hints.title: In-Place Reconstruction
hints.text: Traverse the original string and place the sorted vowels sequentially back into the vowel positions.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Extract vowels, sort by ASCII order, and insert back at original vowel positions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Consonants must stay strictly in their original positions, so whole string sorting is incorrect.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n log n) time dominated by vowel sorting and O(n) space for string reconstruction.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly handle both lowercase and uppercase vowels and their exact ASCII order.
